trigger_condition: HOME (macOS) or USERPROFILE (Windows) env var is unset or empty
guard_snippet: let home = std::env::var("HOME").ok().filter(|s| !s.is_empty())... else return an explicit error/fallback dir
potential_consequence: log_dir resolves to a root-relative or drive-relative path; log writes/reads silently go to the wrong place

trigger_condition: Windows log_dir_with returns backslash path, log_path() still joins filename with a literal '/'
potential_consequence: resulting path mixes '\\' and '/' on Windows before being handed to cmd.exe's start

trigger_condition: log file is deleted/becomes unreadable between ensure_log_readable's check and spawn_open's actual launch
guard_snippet: check spawn_open's child exit status or surface a follow-up error instead of trusting spawn() success
potential_consequence: TOCTOU race: open_log reports success while nothing actually opens for the user

trigger_condition: no application is associated with the .log extension on the target Windows machine
guard_snippet: check the exit code of the spawned cmd/start process and surface an error if it indicates no handler
potential_consequence: 'start "" path' silently no-ops; spawn() still resolves Ok so the UI shows success though nothing opened

trigger_condition: bridge.runner.runStream('codemie doctor', ...) rejects (binary missing, run_stream IPC error)
guard_snippet: try { await bridge.runner.runStream(...) } catch (e) { showLogError(views.health, ...) } finally { }
potential_consequence: unhandled promise rejection; Health view is stuck on 'Checking…' forever with no error shown

trigger_condition: user clicks 'Check everything again' or 'Open today's log' while a prior runHealthCheck/invoke is still in flight
guard_snippet: guard runHealthCheck with a healthRunning flag like installRunning; skip re-entrant calls
potential_consequence: second showLoading() wipes the DOM mid-flight; overlapping renders race and can leave a stale 'Checking…' state

trigger_condition: showLoading() clears container.innerHTML while an earlier onOpenLog catch handler is still pending
guard_snippet: showLogError: if (!el) { console.warn(message); return; } or re-render the error banner independent of the row list
potential_consequence: showLogError's querySelector('.health-log-error') finds nothing and silently drops the error, no user feedback

trigger_condition: a detail line uses a status glyph outside ✓⚠✗○• (future CLI output change)
guard_snippet: fallback branch: if (!detail && /^\s{2}\S/.test(line) && currentName) push an 'unknown' record instead of dropping
potential_consequence: the entire check result is silently dropped; the check disappears from the Health screen with no trace

trigger_condition: a hint line is indented by other than exactly 6 spaces (formatter drift/off-by-one)
guard_snippet: const hintMatch = lines[i+1] && lines[i+1].match(/^\s{4,}(.+)$/); // tolerate a range, not an exact count
potential_consequence: remediation hint text is silently lost; the record is pushed with hint undefined and no error logged

trigger_condition: a header line ('Name:') is followed by zero detail lines before the next blank line
guard_snippet: on blank-line reset, if currentName had no records pushed, emit a placeholder/error record for it
potential_consequence: that check silently vanishes from doctor output and from the Health screen instead of surfacing as missing/failed

trigger_condition: codemie doctor produces no stdout at all (crash before first line, or run_stream resolves with empty output)
guard_snippet: if (records.length === 0) renderHealth shows an explicit 'could not determine health' state instead of 0/0
potential_consequence: groupDoctorResults returns rows: [], summary {passing:0,total:0}; UI shows '0 of 0 fine', indistinguishable from a real all-clear

trigger_condition: a future action.kind value other than 'recheck' or 'navigate' reaches buildRow's onclick ternary
potential_consequence: unknown kind falls through to onNavigate(row.action.view) with an unexpected/undefined view

trigger_condition: showView(name) is called with a name absent from the views map (e.g. undefined action.view)
guard_snippet: if (!views[name]) return; // or default to 'home' before toggling hidden
potential_consequence: every entry in views fails key !== name, hiding all views at once and leaving a blank screen
